_comment: S1 — determinism, numerical noise floor, runtime and memory. The floor recorded here bounds what any later stage is allowed to call signal.

da3mono_large.precision: float32 (no autocast; MPS supports only bf16/fp16 autocast)

subset.role: lower-texture lateral glide / weak geometry support

da3mono_large.subset_rationale: A representative subset, not the 288-frame benchmark. Determinism and runtime do not need the full set, and FREEZE S1 explicitly does not ask for it.
da3mono_large.compared_field: canonical_range where the model emits one, otherwise the NATIVE field — so the floor is in the units the S2 alignment policy will actually work in

wreck_05/f000109.role: lower-texture lateral glide / weak geometry support

noise_floor.meaning: Worst 99th-percentile RELATIVE difference between repeated runs on identical input. No downstream relative delta below this may be read as signal for this model.

da3mono_large.stochasticity_source: none observed — bitwise reproducible on this device and precision
